dataset_name: QuantLib published European call option reference values
purpose: Independent numerical oracle regression fixtures; never training, validation, or search data.
upstream_attribution: E. G. Haug, Option pricing formulas, McGraw-Hill, 1998; as published in the QuantLib test suite.
transformation: Select all Option::Call rows from testValues; rename/reorder columns, retain numerical values without recalculation. source_row is 1-based upstream line number.

units.maturity_years: year fraction supplied by source, not calendar-day recomputation

date_convention: QuantLib source uses Actual360 and timeToDays(t); all selected t*360 are integral. Retaining the supplied t reproduces the source times exactly.
precision: Expected prices rounded to four decimals by source; use supplied 1e-4 absolute tolerance. Do not treat expected_price as full precision.

local_independent_formula_check.implementation: Python standard library math.erfc normal CDF, no repo pricer imported
